name: Lustful Vampire
source:
This story is about how a jewel seeker was looking for a very expensive ring. But instead of a ring, she met a vampire who simply fucked her in all holes!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231960]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个讲述女寻宝猎人四处寻找一枚天价戒指的故事。然而她没能找到戒指，反而撞见了一名吸血鬼，全身上下所有穴口都被对方狠狠贯穿了一遍！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231960]Steam[/url]]
